frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Relational/positional ADVANCE: to come to occupy a position ahead of a specified reference point along an ordering (time, a physical course, or attainment/rank), so that the reference point is left behind, not-yet-reached, outrun, or foreclosed. The root is inherently comparative — it always presupposes a second point that is behind, later, outpaced, or pre-empted. WHICH ordering (space/time/rank) and WHICH relation (overtake / escape / pre-empt / be-foremost) is supplied by the construction (particle, subject, form), not by the root itself.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: sbq is about being or getting AHEAD of something on some ordered line. On a course it is to overtake or race past (Joseph's brothers racing, night not outstripping day); toward God as reference it is the (always-failed) attempt to get beyond His reach; with a decree/allotment as subject it is a word or good outcome that already stands ahead of and forecloses a judgment; and as the participle sabiq it is the front-runner, the foremost in faith or good works. One relational idea — position-ahead-of-a-reference — read on three axes (time, space, rank).
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: sbq does NOT entail: (1) speed/haste — 23:61 places yusariAuwn (hasten) and sabiquwn (be-ahead) as distinct adjacent notions, and the decree uses have zero velocity content; (2) catching-up-from-behind — 36:40 lexically opposes sbq to tudrik/adraka (drk = close a gap from behind; sbq = open a gap in front); (3) moral value — 7:80/29:28 is first-in-an-obscenity (faaHishah) vs 9:100/59:10 first-in-faith, so valence comes from the object, never from sbq; (4) success when the reference is God — the escape sense is chronically asserted-then-negated (8:59 with the gloss laa yuAjizuwn; 29:4; 29:39; 56:60; 70:41; 15:5), so 'outstrip' does NOT equal 'successfully escape'; (5) a present competitor in every case — the decree/allotment uses (Class A, incl. 21:101) have no rival, only bare antecedence; (6) winning a prize — the reward (al-Husnaa, maghfirah, jannah) is always named separately from the sbq word.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 21:101:3:1 — inna alladhiina sabaqat lahum minnaa al-Husnaa. The grammatical subject of sabaqat is al-Husnaa (the good outcome), which 'preceded FOR them' (benefactive laam). There is no course, no rival, nothing left behind — only 'was already appointed/stands prior.' If the nucleus is fixed at the distinctive, information-rich reading that Class B and 36:40 actually license (outstrip / get ahead of a rival / be un-overtakeable), 21:101 refutes it outright: the good does not 'outstrip' anyone. Unity is preserved only by retreating to bare temporal antecedence, which is precisely the thin end of the account — the concession that caps the grade at MODERATE.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A two-sense split that is NOT Quran-internally bridged: (i) sbq1 = antecede in time/order (the decree collocation kalimah/kitaab/qawl sabaqat; maa qad sabaqa; and 'first-in-an-act' 46:11, 59:10) with NO 'cannot-be-caught' entailment; versus (ii) sbq2 = outstrip / get ahead in a course so the other is left behind or cannot reach (Class B escape-God + racing Class VIII/III + foremost-in-a-field). The evidence for the split is collocational segregation: the decree field takes ONLY the perfect verb with a decree-noun subject and NEVER Form VIII or istabiqu al-khayraat; the agentive field never takes kalimah as subject. No verse derives one field from the other; the only binder is shared morphology (which the contract bars as semantic authority) plus a 'position-ahead-in-order' abstraction thin enough to risk fitting everything. This is a genuine chained/radial polysemy whose endpoints (pure prior-decree vs. un-overtakeable outstripping) share none of each other's DISTINCTIVE entailments — the textbook case where a single distinctive nucleus is not established.

internal_discovery.rationale: A single narrow account — relational advance to a position ahead of a reference point (time/course/rank) — is CONSISTENT across all 37 occurrences, is text-internally distinctive (separated from srA 'hasten' at 23:61, from drk 'catch/reach' at 36:40, and from sbH 'glide' at 79:1-4), is morally neutral (bare precedence, valence from the object), and is supported by a regular particle system that predictably encodes the reference relation (direct object = point outrun; Aalaa = decree ahead to one's detriment 11:40/23:27; laam = allotment ahead to one's benefit 21:101; bi- = domain one is ahead in 21:27/35:32/59:10; ilaa = goal reached first 46:11/57:21; accusative after Form VIII = target raced for 12:25/36:66/2:148). That breadth and cleanliness put the floor above WEAK and above UNRESOLVED (the account genuinely fits; there is no unbridgeable homonymy that forces multi-class). But the contract's STRONG bar ('no coherent resistant sub-class') is NOT met: the decree/allotment sub-class (~11 occ, incl. the near-lexicalized kalimatun sabaqat formula recited many times, the nominalized honorific title al-saabiquwn, and the referent-opaque al-saabiqaat 79:4) is coherent and reads transparently as 'prior determination' rather than as a live 'overtake,' and 21:101 supplies material resistance to any rival-outrunning reading. Per the stated policy that a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class or material resistance caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE, MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE (DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY) is the non-over-graded honest result. Two of three lenses (A, C) converge here; lens B's STRONG/UNIVERSAL is rejected precisely on the lexicalized-collocation ground it self-identified as its one point of reasonable doubt.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Impersonal prior determination / temporal antecedence: a decree-noun subject (kalimah, kitaab, qawl) or 'what is past' stands AHEAD of and thereby forecloses a reference event — lawlaa kalimatun sabaqat ... laquDiya / lamassakum ; man sabaqa Aalayhi al-qawl (decree stands against him) ; sabaqat lahum al-Husnaa (allotment stands for them) ; maa qad sabaqa (former matters). The precedence pre-empts an alternative judgment/punishment; the relation is set by particle (Aalaa = to detriment, laam = to benefit).
clusters.classification_rationale: All are Form I perfect with a non-agentive decree/abstract subject; no course, no pursuer, no speed. They fit the precedence nucleus via the pre-emption structure but read most naturally as bare 'already established/elapsed,' which is why this class does not independently, productively confirm the distinctive 'overtake' force.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Agentive outstripping / getting beyond reach, i.e. advance PAST a pursuer or fixed limit — the semantically richest and most distinctive use. maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa (no nation gets ahead of its term); laa yasbiquwnahu bi-l-qawl (angels do not get ahead of Him in speech); an yasbiquunaa / sabaquu (they imagine they got clear); bi-masbuwqiin (We cannot be forestalled). The 'escape/thwart' entailment is the predictable pragmatic result of outstripping an un-outstrippable reference (God/His term), and is uniformly negated or false belief.
clusters.classification_rationale: Reference point is a pursuer/decreer that cannot in fact be passed; the Quran supplies its own gloss (8:59 innahum laa yuAjizuun). 'Escape' is compositional, not a lexicalized second sense — it never freezes into a form meaning 'escape' outside a God-as-reference frame.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 36:40 (in the foremost cluster) opposes sbq to drk in one verse, pinning this class's contribution as 'run past / open a gap in front,' not 'catch up.' The chronic assertion-then-negation (8:59, 29:4, 29:39, 56:60, 70:41, 15:5) confirms 'outstrip' does not entail success.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Being foremost / getting there first along an ordering — participle saabiq 'the one ahead' (hum lahaa saabiquwn 23:61; saabiqun bi-l-khayraat 35:32; al-saabiquwn al-saabiquwn 56:10; al-saabiquwn al-awwaluwn 9:100) and Form I 'precede another in performing/attaining an act' (maa sabaqakum bihaa min aHad 7:80/29:28; maa sabaquunaa ilayhi 46:11; sabaquunaa bi-l-iimaan 59:10), plus celestial overtaking (wa-laa al-laylu saabiqu al-nahaar 36:40).
clusters.classification_rationale: 'Foremost' is position-relative-to-others, not speed (23:61 pairs it with yusariAuwn) and not mere ordinal firstness (9:100 pairs saabiq with awwal, so awwal would be redundant if sbq meant 'first'). 36:40 positively isolates the contribution via the sbq/drk contrast. Moral valence is object-supplied (first-in-obscenity 7:80 vs first-in-faith 59:10).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 36:40 (sbq vs drk) and 23:61 (sbq vs srA) are adversarially clean, distinctive contrasts; 7:80 vs 59:10 shows the bare, valence-free precedence.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Mutual/reciprocal racing or vying to get ahead — Form VIII istabaqa (nastabiqu 12:17; istabaqaa al-baab 12:25 literal foot-race; istabaquu al-Siraat 36:66; istabiquu al-khayraat 2:148/5:48 metaphorical goal), Form III saabaqa (saabiquu ilaa maghfirah 57:21), and the agent+cognate-accusative al-saabiqaat sabqan 79:4. The derivational family maps regularly onto the advance nucleus: reciprocal 'race one another / compete to be foremost.'

reconciliation.rationale: Retained as CONSISTENT under the thin precedence nucleus (bare antecedence with benefactive laam) and via the pre-emption structure (uwlaaika Aanhaa mubAaduwn), but its resistance to the DISTINCTIVE reading is preserved as the strongest_counterexample and is the principal reason the grade is capped at MODERATE rather than STRONG.

The sbq contribution (getting-ahead/racing) is determinable from form and cognate masdar even though the referent is not; classified CONSISTENT for the root claim while the referent-level uncertainty is recorded as a hard case, not exported into the root meaning.

adversarial_verification.notes: The precedence/advance nucleus is distinctive (isolated by the internal contrasts sbq vs drk 36:40, sbq vs srA 23:61, sbq vs sbH 79:4) and covers all 37 occurrences, so the core is not refuted. independent_verification: Two of three independent lenses (A, C) converged on MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE on exactly these grounds; lens B's STRONG/UNIVERSAL was rejected on its own self-identified point of doubt (the lexicalized decree/escape collocations).
candidate_root_contribution: Relational/positional ADVANCE: to come to occupy a position ahead of a specified reference point along an ordering (time, a physical course, or attainment/rank), so that the reference point is left behind, not-yet-reached, outrun, or foreclosed. The root is inherently comparative — it always presupposes a second point that is behind, later, outpaced, or pre-empted. WHICH ordering (space/time/rank) and WHICH relation (overtake / escape / pre-empt / be-foremost) is supplied by the construction (particle, subject, form), not by the root itself.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 37 confirmed occurrences read in full: 20 Form I base verbs (qac_verb_form null), 5 Form VIII, 1 Form III, 11 nominals (participle saabiq/saabiqaat, passive masbuwqiin, cognate masdar sabqan), verified against packet verse_text and word_refs.
layer_attribution.derivation: One relational nucleus (position-ahead-of-a-reference on an ordering) maps regularly across the derivational family: Form VIII/III = reciprocal race/vie; active participle saabiq = the-one-ahead; passive masbuwq = the-one-outstripped/forestalled; masdar sabq = the act; the attached particle (direct object / Aalaa / laam / bi- / ilaa / accusative-after-VIII) supplies the specific reference relation.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A coherent lexicalized/nominal sub-class exists — the fixed decree collocation kalimatun/kitaabun sabaqat and man sabaqa Aalayhi al-qawl, plus the honorific nominal title al-saabiquwn (al-saabiquwn/al-awwaluwn) — which reads as 'prior determination' / a class-label rather than a live 'overtake,' capping scope at REPRESENTATIVE (DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY).
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Context supplies WHICH axis and relation and WHICH valence: God-as-reference yields the (failed) escape reading; a decree-noun subject yields prior-determination; the object (al-khayraat / al-iimaan / al-faaHishah) supplies moral valence. These are contextual/narrative specializations and are deliberately NOT promoted into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary RESISTANT/STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY flags on 21:101 and 79:4 were reconciled to CONSISTENT under the thin nucleus while preserving their boundary force as hard cases; the STRONG/UNIVERSAL proposal (lens B) was reconciled downward to MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE per the resistant-lexicalized-sub-class policy shared by lenses A and C.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: Residual resistance: 21:101 (bare benefactive antecedence, no rival) as the strongest counterexample to a distinctive nucleus; the near-frozen decree formula and honorific title as a coherent lexicalized sub-class; 79:4 unresolved at the referent level; and the 'thwart' lean of passive masbuwqiin (56:60/70:41). rejection_condition.challenging_finding: That the decree/allotment collocation (kalimah/kitaab/qawl sabaqat, and 21:101 al-Husnaa) and the agentive outstrip/race field are two Quran-internally UNBRIDGED senses, so no single distinctive nucleus holds and the result should drop to UNRESOLVED (multi-class) rather than a MODERATE root generalization.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 11 prior-determination occurrences (10:19, 11:110, 20:129, 37:171, 41:45, 42:14, 8:68, 11:40, 23:27, 21:101, 20:99) tested against the Form VIII/III racing and Class B escape occurrences (12:25, 36:66, 2:148, 5:48, 57:21; 29:4, 8:59, 56:60, 70:41, 15:5).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether any verse derives one field from the other (e.g. a decree subject taking a Form VIII racing frame, or an agentive subject taking kalimah), and whether the pre-emption structure (lawlaa ... sabaqat ... laquDiya) supplies an explicit foreclosed reference event that reconnects the decree use to 'advance-past-a-reference.'
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not treat shared triliteral morphology or a shared English gloss ('precede') as evidence of one sense (contract bars morphology as semantic authority); require a positive Quran-internal construction linking the fields, and reject a nucleus so abstract it fits everything without distinctive content.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no verse bridges the fields AND the pre-emption reconnection is judged vacuous, downgrade research_state to UNRESOLVED, result_strength to UNRESOLVED, claim_scope to LOCAL, claim_scope_kind to UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY, and report a two-class (antecedence vs outstrip) result instead of the current MODERATE generalization.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal occurrence is found in which a decree-noun subject (kalimah/kitaab/qawl) takes a Form VIII/III reciprocal racing frame or an ilaa-goal, this would bridge the prior-determination and race/vie fields and could raise scope toward UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION.

If re-analysis shows 21:101 (sabaqat lahum al-Husnaa) and 20:99 (maa qad sabaqa) cannot be sustained under the pre-emption/antecedence reading and instead require a sense disjoint from the outstrip field, downgrade to a two-class UNRESOLVED result.
If the referent of al-saabiqaat (79:4) becomes Quran-internally fixable, re-evaluate whether the race/vie cluster's contribution shifts and whether 79:4 should move clusters.

If the passive masbuwqiin (56:60, 70:41) is shown to lexicalize a 'thwart/prevent' sense independent of an outstrip-a-pursuer frame, reopen the outstrip_escape_forestall cluster as a candidate separate sense.

A formal SUPPORTED falsification pass is NOT claimed because a coherent lexicalized/nominal sub-class (decree formula + honorific title + referent-opaque 79:4) and the 21:101 material counterexample resist the DISTINCTIVE reading; per policy these cap the grade at MODERATE and mean PASSED cannot be asserted. No occurrence outright fails the thin nucleus, so the status is NOT_RUN with the resistant items recorded as hard cases, not FAILED.
